description: This file contains utility methods for manipulating arrays within the Apache Commons Math library. It includes functions for scaling, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, distance calculations, sorting, copying, normalization, convolution, shuffling, and various checks related to array properties. Specifically, it defines the MathArrays class and related interfaces/enums, encapsulating array operations used across mathematical computations.

classes.name: MathArrays
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for array operations. It includes methods for scaling, arithmetic operations, distance calculations, sorting, copying, normalization, convolution, shuffling, and validation checks, often used to support mathematical and statistical computations in the Apache Commons Math library.

methods.name: scale
methods.description: Create a copy of an array scaled by a value.

methods.name: scaleInPlace
methods.description: Multiply each element of an array by a value, modifying the array in place.

methods.name: ebeAdd
methods.description: Element-by-element addition of two arrays.

methods.name: ebeSubtract
methods.description: Element-by-element subtraction of two arrays.

methods.name: ebeMultiply
methods.description: Element-by-element multiplication of two arrays.

methods.name: ebeDivide
methods.description: Element-by-element division of two arrays.

methods.name: distance1
methods.description: Calculate the L1 (Manhattan) distance between two points, for double[] or int[].

methods.name: distance
methods.description: Calculate the Euclidean distance between two points, for double[] or int[].

methods.name: distanceInf
methods.description: Calculate the L-infinity (Chebyshev) distance between two points, for double[] or int[].

methods.name: isMonotonic
methods.description: Check if an array is monotonically increasing or decreasing, for generic types or doubles.

methods.name: checkOrder
methods.description: Verify if an array is sorted in specified order, throws exception if not.

methods.name: checkRectangular
methods.description: Verify array is rectangular (multi-dimensional arrays).

methods.name: checkPositive
methods.description: Ensure all entries in an array are strictly positive.

methods.name: checkNotNaN
methods.description: Ensure no entries in a double array are NaN.

methods.name: checkNonNegative
methods.description: Ensure no entries in an array are negative.

methods.name: safeNorm
methods.description: Compute the Cartesian (2-norm) of a vector with numerical stability.

methods.name: sortInPlace
methods.description: Sort an array in place and reorder additional arrays accordingly, with specified order direction.

methods.name: copyOf
methods.description: Create a copy of an array, with optional length parameter.

methods.name: copyOfRange
methods.description: Copy a range from an array.

methods.name: linearCombination
methods.description: Accurately compute a sum of products of arrays or individual doubles, using specialized algorithms for numerical stability.

methods.name: convolve
methods.description: Compute the convolution of two sequences.

methods.name: shuffle
methods.description: Randomly permute elements of an array or subarray.

methods.name: natural
methods.description: Generate a sequence of natural numbers from 0 to n-1.

methods.name: verifyValues
methods.description: Verify that array indices and values designate a valid subarray and, optionally, check weights.

methods.name: verifyValues
methods.description: Verifies that subarray defined by begin and length has positive length, and that the weights array contains valid, non-negative, finite, non-NaN, and at least one positive value. Throws exceptions if inputs are invalid or conditions are not met.

methods.name: verifyValues
methods.description: Overloaded version that also allows for empty subarrays if allowEmpty is true, providing more flexible validation of array segments and weights.
